|lore=Darth Sidious’ command was merciless and direct. He left no room for misinterpretation.
|game_text=Deploy on a site. Unless a player controls a battleground site, that player’s [[Permanent Weapon|Permanent Weapon]] destiny draws are -2. During opponent’s draw phase, if opponent’s non-battleground site (with no related locations) on table, may activate or retrieve 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The [[Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon) (Original 2005)|2005 original wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. The remaster redevelops the Effect as a site deployment with a permanent-weapon destiny penalty and draw-phase Force action. The May slip prints collector 49, while the December 2006 slip prints collector 50. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16602#page=4 Players Committee original sheet, p. 4, slip 49]. [[:File:VS9O-50-Wipe_Them_Out_All_Of_Them.png|Publisher slip]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards9.pdf#page=4 Players Committee remastered sheet, p. 4, slip 50]. The original slip credits Michael Raveling’s design and the 2004 Minnesota State win.

[[:File:Holotable-OVS9-Wipe-Them-Out-All-Of-Them-v17.gif|Retained full-card rendering]].

[[:File:OVS9-50-Wipe_Them_Out_All_Of_Them-remaster.webp|Retained full-card rendering]].
